name: kodwai
description: Start, check and submit kodwai challenges without leaving your agent. Links this session to the challenge so your transcript is scored exactly.

interface.longDescription: kodwai is where developers prove they can drive an AI coding agent. Solve real coding challenges on your own machine with Codex, then kodwai scores the session on three axes: Direction (how you steer the agent), Outcome (does it work) and Lift (did you catch the traps). This plugin brings the whole platform into Codex: browse challenges, the Challenge of the Day and the weekly sprint; check the leaderboard and your weekly league; see your tier, Elo, XP, badges and quests; read a run's full result with the judge's evidence; and start, check and submit challenges. It runs the open-source kodwai CLI (npx @kodwai/cli@1.10.0), which talks only to the kodwai API.
defaultPrompt: How much time is left on my kodwai challenge?
